You took eleven trades today. Your edge only shows up in three of them. The other eight weren't setups. They were something to do between the ones that mattered.

Effort isn't the same as edge. One is felt. The other is measured. Because activity feels like control. Waiting doesn't feel like anything at all — which is exactly why it gets skipped.

It's in the trades that didn't need to exist. Count them before you count your wins.
